reason: Modelled from the M5Stack schematic: each button shorts its line to GND, and a 10k/20k divider from 5 V holds a released line at about 3.3 V (active low, levelV 3.3). Grove order is BLUE (white), RED (yellow), 5V, GND. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/dual_button (J1 pin1 A, pin2 B, pin3 VCC, pin4 GND in the schematic; white=Blue Btn, yellow=Red Btn)
